markers.name: PORTAL_Arrival
markers.note: Arrival point and ejection portal origin.

markers.name: INT_The_Standing_Portals
markers.note: Six frames with nothing holding them up. Each one is lit a different colour.

markers.name: INT_The_Campfire
markers.note: The community panel's fire. Players sitting here hear each other clearly regardless of proximity falloff — the one place voice does not fade.

markers.name: INT_Trail_Markers
markers.note: Stones stacked by players. Each stack names a reality and a warning.

markers.name: INT_The_Old_Bench
markers.note: Facing the portals. Worn smooth in two places.

markers.name: INT_Moss_Clock
markers.note: Tells the time in whichever reality you last visited.

markers.name: INT_The_Returning_Path
markers.note: Leads back to your trailer on foot. Takes four minutes. Worth doing once.

markers.name: INT_Lantern_Tree
markers.note: Hang a lantern to leave a message for whoever arrives next.

markers.name: INT_The_Listening_Stone
markers.note: Plays back the last thing said in this glade.
